# Golden Padel Club Tanger - Factual Summary

## General Info
- **Name**: Golden Padel Club
- **Type**: Premium Indoor Padel Club (Sports Activity Location)
- **Location**: Marjane Route de Rabat, Tanger, Maroc (Near Marjane supermarket)

## Facilities & Courts
- **Total Courts**: 4 indoor (covered) courts
- **Surface listed by the club**: Mondo Supercourt

## Opening Hours
- **Every Day (7/7)**: 09:00 - 00:00 (Midnight)

## Pricing
- **Court Rental (90 minutes, 4 people)**: 400 MAD total (100 MAD per person when shared equally)
- **Racket Rental**: 20 MAD per racket, extra

## Booking & Reservation
- **Booking Flow**: Select a date and time slot on the website. The club contacts the customer to confirm the request.
- **Direct Reservation Link**: https://wa.me/212664851592
